    authaz apply [OPTIONS]

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help                   Prints help information                        
        --dashboard-url          Dashboard BFF base URL (default:               
                                 https://dashboard.authaz.io)                   
        --profile                Named local session profile (default: default) 
        --identity-prefix        Identity service path prefix (default: /api).  
                                 Set to empty string for host-based routing

                                 application is created (or upserted by the     
                                 YAML's metadata.id)                            
        --file <PATH>            Path to the YAML configuration file            
        --yes                    Skip confirmation prompt                       
        --force                  Skip ETag check
